usdRate.sourceName: BCEAO reference rate of the US dollar against the CFA franc
usdRate.note: 587.14 francs per dollar on 30 October 2026; the franc is fixed at 655.957 per euro. World Bank 2025 average 581.9.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the Institut National de la Statistique (INS) of Côte d'Ivoire, CPI September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 1.6% year on year in September 2026 (1.2% in August, which the BCEAO's September 2026 economic note confirms); secondary source because the INS site could not be reached.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCEAO inflation target range of 1-3% (centre 2%); UEMOA inflation 3.5% in 2024, 0.0% in 2025, 1.0% expected for 2026
inflation_projection.note: The franc is pegged to the euro and the BCEAO aims at 2% within a 1-3% band, which matches the recent average, so 2% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCEAO Monetary Policy Committee, 9 September 2026: main policy rate (minimum bid rate on liquidity tenders)
policy_rate.note: Held at 3.00% (in force since 16 March 2026); marginal lending facility 5.00%.

savings_account_rate.note: No current savings-account rate for Côte d'Ivoire was found; the BCEAO publishes only an average deposit rate for the Union.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate for Côte d'Ivoire was found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate for Côte d'Ivoire was found.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: The BCEAO's September 2026 economic note gives only the Union-wide average deposit rate (5.15% in July 2026) and says Côte d'Ivoire's fell 16 basis points; the country figure itself was not found.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: The Treasury sells bonds to the public by public offering (appel public à l'épargne), but the rate of a current issue could not be confirmed from an official page.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No recent 91-day bill auction for Côte d'Ivoire was found; the latest 12-month bill (20 October 2026) yielded 3.89% on average (UMOA-Titres).

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres (UEMOA public securities agency), Côte d'Ivoire Treasury bond auction of 27 October 2026, 5-year bond
tbond_5y_rate.note: Weighted average yield 7.04% on the 60-month bond (coupon 5.45%); 7.03% at the 20 October auction.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year bond auction for Côte d'Ivoire was found in October 2026; the longest recent auction was 7 years at 7.11-7.18% (UMOA-Titres).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Côte d'Ivoire, withholding taxes (tax on income from debt claims, IRC)
tax_bank_interest.note: The general rate on interest is 18%, reduced to 13.5% for individuals on bank deposit interest; 25% on cash certificates.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Côte d'Ivoire, withholding taxes
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Income realised by individuals on Treasury bonds is exempt from tax.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: The UEMOA deposit guarantee and resolution fund (FGDR-UMOA) covers bank deposits, but its cover limit could not be read from an official source (its site could not be reached).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No current usury cap or typical credit card rate for Côte d'Ivoire was found; the Union-wide average lending rate was 6.70% in July 2026 (BCEAO).

equity_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO: UEMOA government bond yields about 7%; regional stock exchange in Abidjan with a volatile 10-year record
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a decade like 2016-2020, when the regional index fell sharply.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Assumed after-tax safe rate 4.5% (deposits) and tax-free government bonds about 7% (UMOA-Titres, October 2026)
equity_return_base.note: Base case for regional equities including dividends, held about 3.5 points above the after-tax deposit rate because the index's 10-year record is uneven.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Regional stock exchange dividend yields and recent recovery
equity_return_high.note: High case: high dividend yields plus moderate price growth.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Franc fixed at 655.957 per euro (BCEAO reference rates)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold prices in euro terms.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Long-run gold trend in euro terms; franc fixed to the euro
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run gold trend of about 4% a year, with no currency gain under the peg.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: UEMOA average deposit rate 5.15% (July 2026); 13.5% tax on deposit interest
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary savings at lower rates after tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: UEMOA average deposit rate 5.15% (July 2026) less 13.5% tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at the Union average rate after tax (about 4.45%).

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Tax-free Treasury bonds for individuals, about 6-7% (UMOA-Titres, October 2026)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: government bonds bought by individuals, whose income is tax-exempt, allowing for lower retail coupons.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life insurance claim settlement ratio for Côte d'Ivoire was found from the regional supervisor (CIMA) or the national insurance directorate.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold, but no published premium rates per XOF 1,000 of cover were found from the regulator or an official source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Côte d'Ivoire
oop_health_share.note: 32.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI series was confirmed; medical costs are planned 2 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI series was confirmed; school costs are planned 1.5 points above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Côte d'Ivoire
life_expectancy.note: 62.1 years in 2024 (men 60.2, women 64.3); UN WPP 2024 gives 62.4 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; the both-sexes figure at 65 is published, the others are the mean of men and women.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 4.66 (2025, World Bank), 5.9 (2040) and 8.4 (2065, populationpyramid.net).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Prévoyance Sociale (CNPS), old-age insurance factsheet
retirement_age_default.note: Pension from 60 with at least 15 years of insured salaried work; early pension from 55 reduced 5% per year of anticipation.

retirement_age_government.note: The civil-service retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: UEMOA average deposit rate 5.15% less 13.5% tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings and short deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: UEMOA average deposit rate 5.15% (July 2026) less 13.5% tax = about 4.45%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the after-tax deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Tax-free Treasury bonds for individuals, about 6-7% (UMOA-Titres)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: government bonds held to maturity, tax-exempt for individuals.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits with weak equity and gold years.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate 4.5%, government bonds about 7%, equity base 8%, gold base 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, government bonds, regional equity funds and gold.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension was found; the CNPS pays contributory pensions only.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension rules were found.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provisions on retirement indemnity could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Prévoyance Sociale (CNPS), old-age insurance factsheet
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory for private-sector employees (6.3% employee and 7.7% employer, PwC Tax Summaries 2026); pension from 60 after 15 years, equal to the average of the best 15 years' salary times 1.33% or 1.70% per year of career, plus 10% per dependent child (up to 3); the factsheet states no automatic indexation, so inflationLinked is false.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.localName: Emprunt obligataire de l'État par appel public à l'épargne
sanchayapatra_5y.localNameEn: Government bond sold to the public
sanchayapatra_5y.note: Treasury bonds sold to individuals through licensed brokers; income is tax-exempt for individuals. The current issue's rate could not be confirmed.

tbill_91d.note: Bills are auctioned to banks on the regional market, and recent Ivorian auctions were 12-month bills only.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned on the regional market; individuals buy through banks or licensed brokers.

tbond_10y.note: No recent 10-year auction was found; the longest recent maturity was 7 years.

equity_fund.note: Funds regulated by the regional financial markets authority invest in shares listed on the regional exchange in Abidjan.

gold.note: Gold is sold mostly as jewellery.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of West African States (Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest, BCEAO)

insuranceRegulator.name: Inter-African Conference on Insurance Markets (CIMA), regional insurance supervisor

pensionScheme.name: National Social Insurance Fund (Caisse Nationale de Prévoyance Sociale, CNPS)

statistics.name: National Institute of Statistics (Institut National de la Statistique, INS)
statistics.note: The site's security certificate was misconfigured when checked.
